description: This source file implements Wi-Fi Easy Connect (DPP) functionality, including processing authentication responses, configuration requests and results, reconfiguration, and handling related callbacks and event processing for Wi-Fi device provisioning.

methods.name: void end_device_provisioning(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx)
methods.description: Cancels DPP session and frees the context for a device provisioning session.

methods.name: void log_dpp_diagnostics(char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs diagnostic messages related to DPP operations with timestamp.

methods.name: void set_dpp_device_context_states(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx,wifi_dpp_state_t state,wifi_activation_status_t activation_status,wifi_enrollee_responder_status_t enrollee_status,PCOSA_DML_WIFI_DPP_STA_CFG pWifiDppSta)
methods.description: Sets the current state, activation status, and enrollee status of a device DPP context.

methods.name: void process_easy_connect_event(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx,wifi_easy_connect_t * module)
methods.description: Handles different stages of the Easy Connect (DPP) process based on the session state, triggering appropriate actions like initiating authentication, processing responses, and confirming configurations.

methods.name: void process_easy_connect_event_timeout(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx,wifi_easy_connect_t * module)
methods.description: Handles timeout events during Easy Connect process, retrying or aborting based on retries count.

methods.name: bool is_matching_easy_connect_event(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx,void * ptr)
methods.description: Checks if a queued event matches given criteria, such as AP index, station MAC, and session state.

methods.name: void dppAuthResponse_callback(UINT apIndex,mac_address_t sta,unsigned char * frame,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving an authentication response frame from a device.

methods.description: Callback invoked when a configuration request frame is received from a device.

methods.name: void dppConfigResult_callback(UINT apIndex,mac_address_t sta,UCHAR * frame,UINT len)

methods.name: void dppReconfigAnnounce_callback(UINT apIndex,mac_address_t sta,UCHAR * frame,UINT len)
methods.description: Callback invoked upon reconfiguration announcement frame, creates context and triggers processing.

methods.name: void dppReconfigAuthResponse_callback(UINT apIndex,mac_address_t sta,unsigned char * frame,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a reconfiguration authentication response frame.

methods.name: int find_best_dpp_channel(wifi_device_dpp_context_t * ctx)
methods.description: Selects the next best DPP channel for reattempts during provisioning.

methods.name: int start_device_provisioning(PCOSA_DML_WIFI_AP pWiFiAP,ULONG staIndex)
methods.description: Initializes and starts the device provisioning process by creating context and pushing start event.

methods.name: void destroy_easy_connect(void)
methods.description: Placeholder for cleaning up Easy Connect resources.

methods.name: PCOSA_DML_WIFI_DPP_CFG find_dpp_dml_wifi_ap(unsigned int apIndex)
methods.description: Finds the DPP configuration for a specified Wi-Fi access point.

methods.name: PCOSA_DML_WIFI_DPP_STA_CFG find_dpp_sta_dml_wifi_ap(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac)
methods.description: Finds the DPP station configuration matching specific AP index and station MAC address.

methods.name: int init_easy_connect()
methods.description: Initializes Easy Connect (DPP) configurations, registers callbacks, and starts frame reception.

methods.description: Retrieves the list of best channels for a given access point in Easy Connect context.
